contents.publications: Published texts: when and by whom

obsidian.text: The lessons are laid out the way the Chalkenso plugin for Obsidian keeps them. Copy the folder “{folder}” from the .zip into your vault’s Chalkenso folder, and the plugin reads every note as synced.

never.text: Passwords, sync tokens, site keys, AI keys and learner links, and nothing from another organisation. Learners are named only on their group’s roster, and next to a survey answer they chose to sign.

readme.title: Chalkenso export: {organization}
readme.own: It has what {name} can open in {organization}.
readme.plain: Every file is plain text (UTF-8), apart from the lessons’ images. CSV files open in any spreadsheet app. Times are in UTC.
readme.obsidian: Copy the folder “{folder}” into your vault’s Chalkenso folder (the plugin’s root folder). The plugin reads every lesson note as synced: tick its version under What to sync, or map the folder with Map folder to a curriculum version. To sync with another Chalkenso server (your own, say), run Disconnect folder from its previous server first, then upload.
readme.never: Passwords, sync tokens, site keys, AI keys and learner links. Nothing from another organisation. Learners are named only on their group’s roster (group-learners.csv), and next to a survey answer they chose to sign.

describe.vault: Your lessons as Markdown notes, laid out the way the Chalkenso plugin for Obsidian keeps them.
describe.curriculums: One folder per version of a course, one note per lesson as it was last saved (the working copy, which can be newer than what learners read). The notes’ properties are the plugin’s: title, arc, shortDescription, status and slug, and its own lessonId, lessonStatus, revision, lastSynced and syncStatus.
describe.groups: One folder per group with its own copy of the lessons, laid out the same way, with the plugin’s README.md. A finished group’s copy is here too.
describe.attachments: The images the lessons use: those embedded with ![[…]] in each folder’s _attachments, those linked with ![](path) at that path.
describe.courses: Every course: its summary, tags and language.
describe.groupList: Every group: its course, dates, the version it reads, its instructors and how many learners it has.
describe.learners: Each group’s roster: the learners’ names as entered on the group page.
describe.versions: Every version of every course, and every group’s copy: when it was made and published, by whom, and its folder in this export.
describe.publications: Every time a lesson was published: its revision, when, by whom, how many blocks were added and removed, and the file with its text.
describe.texts: The text of every published revision of a lesson, one file each, to see what changed.
describe.feedback: Learner feedback and instructor notes, open first and newest first, with replies and the tasks made from them. Learners show as “A learner · group”, as in the app.
describe.tasks: Every task: its status, the lesson it is about, who proposed it, who it is assigned to, its description and its revision plan.
describe.taskNotes: The team’s notes on each task.
describe.team: The people in the organisation, with their roles.

obsidian.title: Connect your Obsidian vault
obsidian.lead: Obsidian is a free notes app that keeps your notes as plain files in a folder on your computer (a vault). With the plugin your lessons live there too, and sync both ways when you say so.

install.title: Install the plugin
install.text: Unzip it into your vault’s .obsidian/plugins folder, then turn on Chalkenso in Obsidian’s Settings → Community plugins.

token.title: Create a token
token.text: Under <link>Create token</link> below. It’s shown once, so copy it.

add.title: Add it in Obsidian
add.text: In Obsidian’s Settings → Chalkenso, set the server to this address, then Add your organisation and paste the token.

obsidian.then: Then tick what to sync and run Sync.
